metadata.title: Donate — Nebula
metadata.description: Support Nebula with a tip on Ko-fi. Nebula is free and always will be.

page.paragraph_2: Nebula is free and always will be. If you enjoy it, a tip helps keep it going.

ko-fi.paragraph_1: Donations go straight to keepvaibin through Ko-fi. Any amount is super welcome!
ko-fi.paragraph_2: Donating is completely optional and does not unlock anything. But any donations help build the features that you request!

footer.paragraph_1: A little closer to the stars.
